curriculum.course_title: Virginia Mathematics Standards of Learning, Grades 1-5
curriculum.note: Companion inventory to VA-G6-G8-2023; enumerates the Grade 1-5 expectations of the same VDOE 2023 SOL framework.

source_notes: The 2023 Mathematics SOL were approved 2023-08-31 and are fully implemented in SY 2024-2025.
Grades 2-5 statements were extracted from the archived VDOE grade-level SOL documents (web.archive.org captures; direct VDOE fetch returns HTTP 403 from this environment).

Grade 1 statements were extracted from the archived VDOE Mathematics Instructional Guide for Grade 1 (document 54562), the official companion that reproduces each standard verbatim, because the Grade 1 SOL document was not archived at check time.
Pack skills (va-gradeN-sol-2024_25.json) reference strand-level identifiers only; provisional links here are generated by strand-prefix match and MUST NOT be treated as verified mappings.

expectations.scope_summary: The student will identify, describe, extend, and create increasing and decreasing patterns with whole numbers, fractions, and decimals, including those in context, using various representations.
The student will investigate and use variables in contextual problems.

The student will apply the data cycle (formulate questions; collect or acquire data; organize and represent data; and analyze data and communicate results) with a focus on line plots (dot plots) and stem-and-leaf plots.
